name: Imagine Film Festival
blurb: Amsterdam's genre film festival for horror, sci-fi and fantasy cinema, with a Guest of Honour and a Career Achievement Award.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'IMAGINE 2026 VINDT PLAATS VAN 29 OKT T/M 8 NOV' ('Imagine 2026 takes place from Oct 29 to Nov 8').

notes: This is a film festival rather than a fan-guest convention, so the only announced guest is the single Guest of Honour (Kiyoshi Kurosawa, receiving a Career Achievement Award and giving a Career Talk), cat 'other' since he is a live-action director, not anime/animation. Venue is multiple Amsterdam cinemas; no single venue name is given on the homepage, so left blank.
